fixtures.docs/migration.md: Approved backfill from orders-v1-* into orders-v2-* using a new projection generation. Its notification gateway is disabled. Live commands remain on orders-v1 until a later cut-over. No historical notification resend is authorized.
fixtures.config/replay.yaml: copyTarget: LIVE; notificationGatewayEnabled: false. This switch configures only the rebuild projector.
fixtures.config/notice-relay.yaml: endpoint: LIVE; subscription: $all; eventType: OrderDispatched; durable checkpoint. No migration exclusion is configured.
fixtures.src/NoticeRelay.java: On each selected OrderDispatched, enqueue a shipping notice through the outbox with dedup key sourceStreamId + ':' + sourceRevision.
fixtures.src/CopyHistory.java: Copies unchanged business payloads to orders-v2 streams using new event IDs and target-assigned metadata.
fixtures.src/ReadAt.java: Temporal query selects events by native creation timestamp.
fixtures.docs/temporal-contract.md: A query asRecordedAt(T) must preserve the original recorded-time interpretation after migration.
fixtures.fixtures/history.jsonl: One OrderDispatched originally recorded on 2026-05-01; its notice is already present in the outbox/effect ledger under the original stream/revision.
fixtures.fixtures/live.jsonl: One unrelated genuine OrderDispatched occurs on an orders-v1 stream while backfill is in progress; its notice has not been sent.
